sensesIntro.en: The core is carried back to something else; the senses move from a value measured by comparison, to a fact tied to a subject, to a person tied to a family.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「被带回别物那里」；义项从以比较为准的数值，到与某个主题相连的事实，再到与家族相连的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two people on steps of different heights, looking the same size.
core.cn: 核心意象：两个人站在不同高度的台阶上比身高。

branches.en: two figures that only make sense together
branches.cn: 只有放在一起才有意义的两个数字

branches.en: facts gathered around one accident
branches.cn: 围绕一场事故汇集的材料

branches.en: an old house left by a cousin
branches.cn: 一位远亲留下的老房子

branches.en: a comparison and a reference to a subject
branches.cn: 一次比较与一次对主题的指向

branches.en: tied to a question and tied to a family
branches.cn: 与一个问题相连，与一个家族相连

intro.en: The participle carried back becomes an adjective of comparison, and the adjective then becomes a noun for a family member.
intro.cn: 「被带回的」分词变成表比较的形容词，这个形容词又变成指亲属的名词。

latinIntro.en: The base is relatus, carried back; -ivus forms the adjective relativus.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 relatus（被带回的）；-ivus 构成形容词 relativus。

definition_en: to become less tense in body or mind; to make a rule or a limit less strict; to become less tight or less severe
core_image: 一直攥紧的拳头在长椅上慢慢松开
scene: 他在长椅上坐了很久，一直攥紧的拳头才慢慢松开。A hot bath helps her relax after a long shift.
sceneCN: 这里 relax 是「放松」（第 1 个义项：身体或心情由紧张转为松弛）；句意为长时间轮班之后，热水澡能帮她放松。画面里可留意：慢慢松开的拳头、长椅。

senses.title: To become less tense
senses.definition: to let the body or the mind become loose and calm
senses.definitionCN: 让身体或心情变得松弛平静
senses.example: A hot bath helps her relax after a long shift.
senses.exampleCN: 长时间轮班之后，热水澡能帮她放松。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to loosen, and the prefix adds a returning: tension that has tightened is let back to its resting state.
senses.whyCN: 这个拉丁动词意为「使松」，前缀则添上「回」的意味：绷紧的张力被放回到休息状态。

senses.title: To make a rule less strict
senses.definition: to make a rule, a limit, or a control less severe
senses.definitionCN: 使规则、限制或管制不那么严格
senses.example: The city relaxed the rules on street markets last spring.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市去年春天放宽了街头集市的规定。
senses.why: A rule can be tight like a muscle, and loosening it is described with the same verb.
senses.whyCN: 规则可以像肌肉一样紧绷，而松开它用的是同一个动词。

senses.title: To become less tight
senses.definition: to become less firm, less intense, or less severe
senses.definitionCN: 变得不那么紧、不那么强烈或不那么严重
senses.example: His grip on the rail relaxed once the ship was steady.
senses.exampleCN: 船稳下来之后，他抓着栏杆的手松了。
senses.why: Here the loosening is physical again, but the object is a hold or a tension rather than a person.
senses.whyCN: 这里的松弛又回到物理层面，只是对象是握力或张力，而不是一个人。

intro.en: Relax is to loosen: the Latin adjective for loose becomes a verb, and the prefix sets the loosening in motion.
intro.cn: relax 意为「使松」：拉丁语表「松」的形容词变成动词，前缀让这一松开得以进行。

items.en: Laxus meant loose, slack, or wide, and it is the root of the whole family.
items.cn: laxus 意为松的、松弛的或宽的，是整个词族的根。

items.en: Laxare meant to loosen, slacken, or let go.
items.cn: laxare 意为放松、使松弛或放开。

items.en: Relaxare added re- and meant to loosen back, to unbend, or to relieve.
items.cn: relaxare 加上 re-，意为松回去、舒展或缓解。

items.en: French relaxer carried the medical sense of easing tension into English.
items.cn: 法语 relaxer 把「缓解紧张」这一医学用法带入英语。

items.en: English widened the verb from muscles and minds to rules, prices, and controls.
items.cn: 英语把这个动词从肌肉与心情扩展到规则、价格与管制。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the Latin adjective for loose; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of resting and easing.
note.cn: 形近组收由拉丁语表「松」的形容词构成的词；近义组收表示休息与缓解的动词。

entries.definition: To make less severe or painful.
To relax after work or stress.

normalIntro.en: The word is loosen plus back: a muscle, a rule, or a grip is allowed to return to slack.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「松开加回来」：肌肉、规则或握力被允许回到松弛。

normal.en: Laxus means loose, and relax means to make loose again.
normal.cn: laxus 意为松，relax 意为重新放松。

normal.en: Relax the rules means let them be less strict.
normal.cn: relax the rules 指让规定不那么严。

normal.en: A relaxed person is one whose shoulders have come down.
normal.cn: a relaxed person 就是肩膀放下来的人。

normal.en: The adjective relaxing describes what does the loosening.
normal.cn: 形容词 relaxing 描述起松弛作用的东西。

normal.en: Release and relax are different words; one lets go, one slackens.
normal.cn: release 与 relax 是两个词：一个放开，一个松弛。

abstract.en: To relax is to stop holding what no longer needs holding.
abstract.cn: 放松，就是停止握住已经不必握住的东西。

abstract.en: A mind that never slackens cannot tell what matters.
abstract.cn: 从不松弛的心，分不清什么要紧。

abstract.en: Some rules deserve to be loosened, and some only appear to.
abstract.cn: 有些规则值得放宽，有些只是看起来如此。

examples.en: A hot bath helps her relax after a long shift.
examples.cn: 长时间轮班之后，热水澡能帮她放松。

examples.en: The city relaxed the rules on street markets last spring.
examples.cn: 这座城市去年春天放宽了街头集市的规定。

examples.en: His grip on the rail relaxed once the ship was steady.
examples.cn: 船稳下来之后，他抓着栏杆的手松了。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（往回）加 lax（松）：把紧绷的肌肉放回松弛，是放松；把绷紧的规定放回松弛，是放宽。

root: 拉丁 laxus（松的）→ laxare（使松）→ relaxare（松回去、缓解）→ 法语 relaxer → 英语 relax；同族有 relaxation、relaxed、relaxing，形近的 lax 也出自 laxus。

sensesIntro.en: The core is slackening; the senses move from a tense body, to a strict rule, to a tight hold.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「变松」；义项从紧绷的身体，到严格的规定，再到握紧的手。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fist that has been clenched for hours slowly opening on a bench.
core.cn: 核心意象：一直攥紧的拳头在长椅上慢慢松开。

branches.en: a bath after a long shift
branches.cn: 长班之后的一次泡澡

branches.en: a market rule made easier
branches.cn: 被放宽的集市规定

branches.en: a hand letting go of a rail
branches.cn: 松开栏杆的手

branches.en: a body and a grip both loosening
branches.cn: 身体与握力同时松开

branches.en: a rule and a mind both eased
branches.cn: 被放宽的规定与松弛下来的心

intro.en: The Latin adjective for loose becomes a verb of loosening, and the prefix turns the action into a return to slack.
intro.cn: 拉丁语表「松」的形容词变成表「使松」的动词，前缀把这一动作变成「松回去」。

latinIntro.en: The base is laxus, loose; laxare means to loosen, and re- means back.
latinIntro.cn: 词根是 laxus（松的）；laxare 意为使松，re- 表「往回」。

definition_zh: 宽慰；缓解；救济；浮雕；换班
definition_en: the good feeling that comes when pain, worry, or trouble stops or becomes less
core_image: 压在肩上的重物被突然搬走，人长长吐出一口气
scene: 手术室的灯灭后，医生摘下口罩说手术很成功，走廊里的人同时松下了肩膀。When the doctor said the operation had succeeded, a wave of relief spread through the corridor.
sceneCN: 这里 relief 是「宽慰、如释重负」（第 1 个义项：痛苦或忧虑解除后的轻松）；句意：医生说手术成功后，走廊里的人们感到一阵宽慰。

pos.zh: 宽慰；缓解；救济；浮雕；换班

derivatives.zh: 由名词 relief 回溯拉丁动词，义为「减轻；缓解」
relieve 加 -ed 构成，义为「感到宽慰的」
relieve 加否定前缀 un- 与 -ed，义为「未获缓解的；单调的」

senses.title: The end of pain or worry
senses.definition: the pleasant feeling you have when pain, anxiety, or a difficult situation ends
senses.definitionCN: 疼痛、焦虑或困境结束后所产生的轻松愉快感
senses.example: She felt a huge sense of relief when the exam results finally arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 考试成绩终于公布时，她感到如释重负。
senses.why: The Latin verb relevare means to raise or lift up, so the core image is a weight being lifted off the body.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词 relevare 表示「抬起、举起」，所以核心画面是压在身上的重物被抬走，紧绷随之松开。

senses.title: Help for people in trouble
senses.definition: money, food, or other help given to people who are in need, especially after a disaster
senses.definitionCN: 给予困境中的人们的钱、食物或其他帮助，尤指灾后援助
senses.example: Relief supplies reached the village two days after the flood.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水过后两天，救援物资运抵了村庄。
senses.why: If the core image is lifting a weight, then lifting people out of hardship naturally gives the word the sense of aid itself.
senses.whyCN: 既然核心画面是把重物抬起，那么把人从苦难中托起来，就自然延伸出「援助」这一义项。

senses.title: A design raised above a surface
senses.definition: a design cut into stone or metal so that it stands out above the flat background
senses.definitionCN: 在石头或金属上雕刻出的、凸出于平面的图案
senses.example: The coin shows the queen's head in relief.
senses.exampleCN: 这枚硬币上铸有女王头像的浮雕。
senses.why: The raised part of a carving is literally lifted above the surface, which matches the lifting image at the heart of the word.
senses.whyCN: 浮雕凸起的部分正是从平面被「抬起来」的，与这个词核心的抬起画面完全吻合。

senses.title: A shift that takes over a duty
senses.definition: a person or group that takes over a job from someone else so that the work can continue
senses.definitionCN: 从他人手中接过工作、使工作中断得以继续的人或班组
senses.example: The night relief arrived at six in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 夜班接替人员早上六点到了。
senses.why: Passing a load from one pair of shoulders to another is the same lifting picture, applied to work shifts.
senses.whyCN: 把重担从一副肩膀交到另一副肩膀，仍是「抬起并转移」这个画面，用在轮班场景里就成了换班。

intro.en: Relief comes through Old French from the Latin verb relevare, built from the prefix re- and the verb levare.
intro.cn: relief 经由古法语来自拉丁动词 relevare，该词由前缀 re- 与动词 levare 组合而成。

items.en: Relevare means to raise up, lift, or lighten, and is formed from re- plus levare.
items.cn: relevare 意为抬起、举起或减轻，由 re- 与 levare 构成。

items.en: Levare comes from the adjective levis, light in weight, the same root found in levity.
items.cn: levare 源自形容词 levis「重量轻的」，这个词根也见于 levity。

items.en: Relevium names a payment raised from a tenant, showing the idea of something lifted up.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁语 relevium 指向佃户征收的一笔款项，同样带有「被抬起之物」的意味。

items.en: Old French relief carries the senses of a raising, of help, and of a remainder.
items.cn: 古法语 relief 同时有「抬起」「帮助」「剩余部分」几层意思。

items.en: English borrows the word for help given to someone in trouble and for a raised carving.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词，用于表示给予困境中人的帮助，也指凸起的雕刻。

items.en: Modern English keeps the eased feeling, the aid, the raised carving, and the relieving shift.
items.cn: 现代英语保留了宽慰感、援助、浮雕以及换班这几层含义。

note.en: Relief belongs to a re- and lev- family about lifting weight, and it sits near words for making trouble smaller.
note.cn: relief 属于由 re- 与 lev- 构成、表示「抬起重量」的词族，同时又与表示「使麻烦变小」的词相邻。

entries.definition: to make pain or a problem less serious
entries.definitionCN: 缓解；减轻，是 relief 对应的动词形式

entries.definition: feeling glad that a worry or pain has gone
entries.definitionCN: 感到宽慰的，由 relieve 加 -ed 构成

entries.definition: a lack of seriousness, often in a situation that needs it
entries.definitionCN: 轻浮；轻率，与 relief 共享 levis「轻」的词根

entries.definition: a pleasant feeling of being free from pain or worry
entries.definitionCN: 舒适；安慰，侧重身心放松的状态

entries.definition: the state of feeling no pain, difficulty, or worry
entries.definitionCN: 轻松；安逸，强调没有负担

entries.definition: help, especially money or goods given to people in need
entries.definitionCN: 援助；救助，与 relief 的第二义项接近

normalIntro.en: The word is built on Latin levare, to lift, so the memory hooks mostly involve lifting a weight.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词建立在拉丁语 levare「举起」之上，所以记忆钩子大多围绕「把重物抬走」。

normal.en: Re- plus lev- gives the picture of lifting something up again, and the weight comes off.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加词根 lev-，画面是把东西重新抬起来，重量随之离开。

normal.en: Compare elevator: both words lift, one lifts people, the other lifts weight off a mind.
normal.cn: 对比 elevator：两者都在「抬起」，一个载人，一个把重量从心头抬走。

normal.en: The pair relief and relieve differs only by the last letter, noun against verb.
normal.cn: relief 与 relieve 只差最后一个字母，一个是名词，一个是动词。

normal.en: A sigh of relief is literally the sound of a lifted weight.
normal.cn: a sigh of relief 字面上就是重物被抬走时那口长气。

normal.en: Disaster relief is help that lifts a whole town back onto its feet.
normal.cn: disaster relief 是把整座城镇重新托起来的援助。

abstract.en: Imagine a backpack of stones sliding off your back; your shoulders drop and you breathe out.
abstract.cn: 想象一包石头从背上滑落，肩膀塌下来，你长长呼气。

abstract.en: Think of a carved coin: the head is pushed up out of the flat metal.
abstract.cn: 想一枚硬币，头像被从平整的金属里顶出来。

abstract.en: Picture a relay of workers: one steps away, the next takes the load.
abstract.cn: 想象工人接力：一个人退下，下一个人接过重物。

examples.en: She breathed a sigh of relief when she heard the news.
examples.cn: 听到这个消息，她松了一口气。

examples.en: The government sent relief to the flooded region.
examples.cn: 政府向洪涝地区运送了救援物资。

examples.en: The statue is carved in relief on the temple wall.
examples.cn: 庙墙上雕着这座雕像的浮雕。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞丽福」——想象瑞丽小城送来福气，紧绷的心一下松开；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 re-（再次、向后）+ levare（举起，源自 levis「轻」）构成 relevare（抬起、减轻），经古法语 relief 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: One image of a lifted weight grows into four senses: the eased mind, the aid given, the raised carving, and the shift that takes over.
sensesIntro.cn: 「抬起重量」这一个画面长出四个义项：心里的轻松、给出的援助、凸起的浮雕，以及接过工作的换班。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heavy weight lifted from the shoulders.
core.cn: 核心意象：压在肩上的重物被抬起搬走。

branches.en: The mind feels the weight go, so relief names the eased feeling.
branches.cn: 心里感到重量消失，于是 relief 指那种松弛下来的感觉。

branches.en: Lifting a person out of hardship becomes the name for the help itself.
branches.cn: 把人从困境中托起来，进一步成为「援助」的名称。

branches.en: A carving stands up above the flat surface, exactly like something lifted.
branches.cn: 浮雕高出平面，正像被抬起的东西。

branches.en: A load passed to fresh hands becomes the relieving shift.
branches.cn: 重担交到新的人手上，就成了接替的班次。

branches.en: Both the eased feeling and the aid come from the same upward movement.
branches.cn: 心中的松弛与外来的援助都源自同一个向上的动作。

intro.en: Relief is built from a Latin prefix and a Latin root, with a French noun ending carried into English.
intro.cn: relief 由拉丁前缀、拉丁词根以及传入英语的法语名词词尾构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin prefix re- means back or again, and levare means to lift, so together they describe lifting a burden away.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 表示「向后、再次」，levare 表示「举起」，合起来就是「把重担抬走」。

items.example: The prefix re- returns in relieve and remove.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 也出现在 relieve 与 remove 中。

items.example: The root lev- also appears in elevate and levity.
items.exampleCN: 词根 lev- 也出现在 elevate 与 levity 中。

items.example: Levare is the verb behind relief and relieve.
items.exampleCN: levare 是 relief 与 relieve 背后的动词。

items.example: Levis is the source of the lev- root in this family.
items.exampleCN: levis 是这一词族中 lev- 词根的来源。

items.meaningCN: 表示结果或状态的名词词尾
items.example: The ending -ief carries the French form into English relief.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ief 把法语形式带进了英语 relief。

items.meaning: to lift up again, to ease
items.example: Relevare joins re- and levare into a single verb.
items.exampleCN: relevare 把 re- 与 levare 合成了一个动词。

items.example: Levity uses the same levis root for lightness of behaviour.
items.exampleCN: levity 用同一个 levis 词根表示举止上的轻。

items.example: Alleviate adds ad- to the same levis root.
items.exampleCN: alleviate 在同一个 levis 词根前加了 ad-。

latinEntries.meaning: a payment raised from a tenant

definition_en: to stay in the same place or condition, or to be left after other things have gone
core_image: 人都走光了，桌上还剩着一只没被收走的杯子
scene: 散场之后，几个学生没有立刻离开，他们留在座位上继续讨论那道题。After the lecture, a few students remained in their seats to argue about the problem.
sceneCN: 这里 remain 是「停留、留下」（第 1 个义项：没有离开原处）；句意：讲座结束后，几个学生留在座位上继续争论那道题。

derivatives.zh: remain 加 -s 构成的名词，义为「残余；遗迹；遗体」
remain 加 -der 构成，义为「剩余部分」
remain 加 -ing 构成，义为「剩余的」

senses.title: To stay in a place
senses.definition: to stay in the same place instead of leaving with the others
senses.definitionCN: 留在原处，而不随其他人离开
senses.example: Only two guests remained after midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 午夜过后，只有两位客人还留在那里。
senses.why: The Latin verb manere means to stay, and re- adds the idea of staying behind, which gives the plain physical sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词 manere 意为「停留」，前缀 re- 带来「留在后面」的意味，于是形成最直白的空间义。

senses.title: To continue to be in a state
senses.definition: to continue to be in a particular condition without changing
senses.definitionCN: 继续保持某种状态而不改变
senses.example: The streets remained empty all night.
senses.exampleCN: 整夜街道都空无一人。
senses.why: Staying in a place widens into staying in a condition, such as silence or safety.
senses.whyCN: 「留在某处」扩展为「留在某种状态里」，例如沉默或安全。

senses.title: To be left over
senses.definition: to still exist after other parts have been used, taken, or destroyed
senses.definitionCN: 在其他部分被使用、拿走或毁掉之后仍然存在
senses.example: Little remained of the old town after the fire.
senses.exampleCN: 大火之后，老城几乎没有剩下什么。
senses.why: What stays behind when everyone and everything else has gone is precisely what remains.
senses.whyCN: 当其他人和物都离开或消失后仍留在原地的，正是「剩下的」。

intro.en: Remain comes from Old French remaindre, from Latin remanere, built on re- and manere, to stay.
intro.cn: remain 来自古法语 remaindre，源自拉丁语 remanere，由 re- 与 manere「停留」构成。

items.en: Remanere means to stay behind or to be left, from re- and manere.
items.cn: remanere 意为留在后面或剩下，由 re- 与 manere 构成。

items.en: Manere is also the source of mansion and permanent, both about staying.
items.cn: manere 也是 mansion 与 permanent 的来源，两者都与「停留」有关。

items.en: Remaindre means to stay, to last, and to be left over.
items.cn: 古法语 remaindre 表示停留、持续以及剩下。

items.en: English remain covers staying in a place and continuing in a state.
items.cn: 英语 remain 同时覆盖留在某地与保持某种状态。

items.en: The plural noun remains develops separately for leftovers, ruins, and the bodies of the dead.
items.cn: 复数名词 remains 另行发展出剩饭、遗迹与遗体等含义。

note.en: Remain is the verb of staying, and its family includes the noun remains and the adjective remaining.
note.cn: remain 是表示「停留」的动词，词族包括名词 remains 与形容词 remaining。

entries.definition: what is left after other parts have gone
entries.definitionCN: 残余；遗迹；遗体，由 remain 加 -s 构成

entries.definition: still present when the rest has gone
entries.definitionCN: 剩余的，由 remain 加 -ing 构成

entries.definition: the part that is left over
entries.definitionCN: 剩余部分，与 remain 同源

entries.definition: to continue to be in a place
entries.definitionCN: 停留，是最日常的近义词

entries.definition: to stay somewhere longer than necessary
entries.definitionCN: 逗留；徘徊，带有不愿离开的意味

entries.definition: to continue to exist or happen

normalIntro.en: The Latin verb manere, to stay, is the spine of this word and of mansion and permanent.
normalIntro.cn: 拉丁动词 manere「停留」是这个词的骨架，也支撑着 mansion 与 permanent。

normal.en: Re- plus manere gives staying behind while everyone else moves on.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加 manere，就是别人都走了，它还留在后面。

normal.en: Mansion and permanent share the same root, one a place that stays, one a state that lasts.
normal.cn: mansion 与 permanent 共享同一词根，一个是留下来的房子，一个是持续的状态。

normal.en: Add -s and the word becomes a noun for leftovers and ruins.
normal.cn: 加 -s 就变成名词，指剩饭与遗迹。

normal.en: The pattern remain silent teaches the linking use: remain plus adjective.
normal.cn: remain silent 这个搭配说明了它的连系用法：remain 加形容词。

normal.en: It remains to be seen is a fixed sentence opener in news writing.
normal.cn: it remains to be seen 是新闻写作中固定的句子开头。

abstract.en: Picture a single cup on a table after the whole party has left.
abstract.cn: 想象聚会散尽后，桌上只留下一个杯子。

abstract.en: See a lighthouse still standing after the village has been abandoned.
abstract.cn: 想象村庄废弃之后，灯塔仍然立着。

abstract.en: Think of a light left on in a window all night.
abstract.cn: 想一扇窗里彻夜亮着的灯。

examples.en: Please remain seated until the plane has stopped.
examples.cn: 飞机停稳之前请留在座位上。

examples.en: The reason for the delay remains a mystery.
examples.cn: 延误的原因仍然是个谜。

examples.en: Very little remained of the original building.
examples.cn: 原来的建筑几乎没有剩下什么。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞梅」——梅花谢了，枝上还剩一朵；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 remaindre，源自拉丁语 remanere（re-「留在后面」+ manere「停留」）。

sensesIntro.en: Staying in a place becomes staying in a state and then being what is left when everything else is gone.
sensesIntro.cn: 留在某处，进而变成留在某种状态，再变成其他一切消失后尚存的部分。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one cup left on the table after everyone has gone.
core.cn: 核心意象：人都走光后，桌上还剩一只杯子。

branches.en: The cup stays where it was, which is the plain sense of remaining in place.
branches.cn: 杯子留在原处，这就是最直白的「停留」义。

branches.en: Staying in a place stretches into staying in a condition.
branches.cn: 留在某处被拉长成留在某种状态里。

branches.en: When everything else is taken away, what stays is what is left over.
branches.cn: 其他一切被拿走之后，留下来的就是剩余之物。

branches.en: Both senses keep the same stillness at the centre.
branches.cn: 两个义项的中心都是同一种静止不动。

branches.en: Physical staying and ongoing state share one root, manere.
branches.cn: 空间上的停留与状态的延续共享同一个词根 manere。

intro.en: Remain is a French-shaped verb whose Latin prefix and root still show in related words.
intro.cn: remain 是法语形态的动词，其拉丁前缀与词根在相关词中仍然可见。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means back or behind, and manere means to stay, so the verb means to stay behind.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 表示「回、在后」，manere 表示「停留」，合起来即「留在后面」。

items.example: Re- gives the sense of staying behind.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 带来「留在后面」的含义。

items.example: The man- root returns in mansion and permanent.
items.exampleCN: man- 词根也出现在 mansion 与 permanent 中。

items.example: Manere is the verb at the heart of remain.
items.exampleCN: manere 是 remain 的核心动词。

items.meaning: more than one, or a mass noun
items.example: Remains turns the verb into a plural noun.
items.exampleCN: remains 把动词变成复数名词。

items.example: Remaining describes what is still there.
items.exampleCN: remaining 描述依然存在的部分。

items.meaningCN: 表示动作结果的名词词尾
items.example: Remainder names the part left over.
Mansion keeps the sense of a place where one stays.
items.exampleCN: mansion 保留了「停留之所」的含义。

items.example: Permanent adds per- to the same manere root.
items.exampleCN: permanent 在同一个 manere 词根前加了 per-。

definition_zh: 记得；想起；记住去做；代问好；纪念
definition_en: to keep something in your mind or bring it back into your mind
core_image: 多年后仍能准确说出那天的天气和气味
scene: 多年以后，她还能说出那家小店门口挂着什么颜色的帘子。Years later, she could still remember the colour of the curtain at the shop door.
sceneCN: 这里 remember 是「记得」（第 1 个义项：把过去的经历保存在心里并能想起）；句意：多年以后，她仍然记得那家店门口帘子的颜色。

derivatives.zh: remember 加 -ance 构成，义为「记忆；纪念」
与 remember 共享拉丁词根 memor，义为「记忆」
由 memor 加 -able 构成，义为「难忘的」

senses.title: To keep something in mind
senses.definition: to have a fact, a name, or an experience stored in your mind and be able to bring it back
senses.definitionCN: 把事实、名字或经历存在心里，并能重新想起来
senses.example: I remember my first day at school very clearly.
senses.exampleCN: 我清楚地记得上学的第一天。
senses.why: The Latin verb rememorari means to be mindful again, so the core image is a stored scene coming back whole.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 rememorari 意为「重新留心」，所以核心画面是储存的场景被完整唤回。

senses.title: To not forget to do something
senses.definition: to keep a future task in mind so that you do not fail to do it
senses.definitionCN: 把将来的任务放在心里，以免忘记去做
senses.example: Remember to lock the door when you leave.
senses.exampleCN: 离开时记得锁门。
senses.why: The stored scene here points forward: keeping a duty in mind until the moment arrives.
senses.whyCN: 这里的记忆指向前方：把职责放在心里，直到该行动的时刻。

senses.title: To send greetings through someone
senses.definition: to ask someone to pass your greetings to another person
senses.definitionCN: 请某人把自己的问候带给另一个人
senses.example: Please remember me to your parents.
senses.exampleCN: 请代我向你父母问好。
senses.why: Holding a person in mind turns into a spoken greeting sent through a third party.
senses.whyCN: 把某人放在心上，就变成托第三个人带去的问候。

senses.title: To honour the memory of someone
senses.definition: to keep the memory of a person or event alive with respect
senses.definitionCN: 怀着敬意让某个人或某件事的记忆继续存在
senses.example: The town holds a service to remember the victims.
senses.exampleCN: 镇上举行仪式纪念遇难者。
senses.why: Keeping a memory is not only recalling it privately but also publicly refusing to let it fade.
senses.whyCN: 让记忆存续不只是私下回想，也是公开地拒绝让它淡去。

intro.en: Remember comes from Old French remembrer, from Latin rememorari, built on re- and memor, mindful.
intro.cn: remember 来自古法语 remembrer，源自拉丁语 rememorari，由 re- 与 memor「留心的、记得的」构成。

items.en: Memor means mindful or remembering, and gives memory, memorial, and memorable.
items.cn: memor 意为「留心的、记得的」，产生了 memory、memorial 与 memorable。

items.en: Rememorari means to recall or call back to mind, adding re- to memor.
items.cn: rememorari 意为回想、重新唤起记忆，在 memor 前加了 re-。

items.en: Remembrer means to recall and also to remind another person.
items.cn: 古法语 remembrer 既表示回想，也表示提醒别人。

items.en: English remember covers recall, keeping a duty in mind, and sending greetings.
items.cn: 英语 remember 覆盖回想、记住职责以及代问好等用法。

items.en: The public sense of honouring the dead grows out of the idea of keeping memory alive.
items.cn: 公开纪念逝者的义项，是从「让记忆继续存在」这一想法发展而来。

note.en: Remember belongs to the memor- family of memory and memorial, and it stands near remind and recall.
note.cn: remember 属于 memory、memorial 所在的 memor- 词族，并与 remind、recall 相邻。

entries.definition: the act of remembering or a thing kept in memory
entries.definitionCN: 记忆；纪念物，由 remember 加 -ance 构成
记忆力；回忆，与 remember 共享 memor 词根

entries.definition: worth remembering because it is special
to bring something back into your mind
entries.definitionCN: 回想起，比 remember 更强调主动调取
记住；背诵，强调刻意背下来

normalIntro.en: The memor- root of mindful is shared with memory and memorial, so the family is easy to keep together.
normalIntro.cn: 表示「留心」的 memor- 词根与 memory、memorial 共用，整族词很容易一起记。

normal.en: Re- plus memor, mindful, means becoming mindful again of something past.
normal.cn: 前缀 re- 加 memor「留心的」，就是重新对过去的事留心。

normal.en: Remember to do looks forward, while remember doing looks back.
normal.cn: remember to do 指向将来，remember doing 指回过去。

normal.en: The noun remembrance adds -ance to the verb stem.
normal.cn: 名词 remembrance 在动词词干后加 -ance。

normal.en: Please remember me to your parents is a polite, slightly formal request.
normal.cn: 「please remember me to your parents」是礼貌而略正式的请求。

normal.en: Memory and memorable keep the same memor- stem without the re- prefix.
normal.cn: memory 与 memorable 保留同一个 memor- 词干，但不带 re- 前缀。

abstract.en: Picture an old photograph sliding out of a drawer, still sharp in every detail.
abstract.cn: 想象一张旧照片从抽屉里滑出来，每个细节依旧清晰。

abstract.en: See a note tied to a door handle so the task cannot be missed.
abstract.cn: 想象门上系着一张纸条，让任务不会被漏掉。

abstract.en: Think of people standing quietly around a stone with names carved on it.
abstract.cn: 想人们安静地围着一块刻着名字的石头站着。

examples.en: I can't remember where I put the keys.
examples.cn: 我想不起来把钥匙放在哪里了。

examples.en: Remember to switch off the lights before you go.
examples.cn: 走之前记得关灯。

examples.en: The ceremony remembers those who died in the war.
examples.cn: 这场仪式纪念在战争中死去的人们。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞曼伯」——想象瑞丽有位曼伯，能把往事一件件说清楚；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古法语 remembrer，源自拉丁语 rememorari（re-「再次」+ memor「留心的、记得的」）。

sensesIntro.en: Keeping something mindful runs in four directions: what happened, what must be done, who should be greeted, and who must not be forgotten.
sensesIntro.cn: 「把某事放在心上」朝四个方向延伸：发生过什么、要做什么、该向谁问好、以及谁不能被忘记。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a past scene returning with every detail intact.
core.cn: 核心意象：过去的场景带着完整细节重新浮现。

branches.en: Bringing a stored scene back is the central sense.
branches.cn: 把储存的场景重新调出，是这个词的中心义。

branches.en: Holding a future duty in mind points the same verb forward.
branches.cn: 把未来的职责放在心上，使这个动词指向前方。

branches.en: Holding a person in mind becomes a greeting sent through another.
branches.cn: 把某人放在心上，变成托人带去的问候。

branches.en: Publicly keeping a memory alive becomes commemoration.
branches.cn: 公开让记忆存续，就成为纪念。

branches.en: Private recall and public remembrance are two scales of one act.
branches.cn: 私下回想与公开纪念是同一个动作的两个尺度。

intro.en: Remember is a Latin-derived verb with a repeated prefix and a root about being mindful.
intro.cn: remember 是拉丁来源的动词，含表重复的前缀与表示「留心」的词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin re- means again, and memor means mindful, so the verb means to become mindful again.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁前缀 re- 表示「再次」，memor 表示「留心的」，动词即「重新留心」。

items.example: Re- marks the return of a memory.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 标记记忆的回返。

items.example: The memor- root also appears in memory.
items.exampleCN: memor- 词根也出现在 memory 中。

items.example: Memor is the adjective behind the whole family.
items.exampleCN: memor 是整族词背后的形容词。

items.meaningCN: 表示状态或行为的名词词尾
items.example: Remembrance names the state of keeping someone in mind.
items.exampleCN: remembrance 指把某人放在心上的状态。

items.meaning: to recall, call back to mind
items.example: Rememorari is the direct Latin ancestor.
items.exampleCN: rememorari 是直接的拉丁祖先。

items.example: Memory and remember split the same stem.
items.exampleCN: memory 与 remember 分担同一个词干。

items.meaning: to honour the memory of someone
items.example: Commemorate adds com- to the same memor root.
items.exampleCN: commemorate 在同一个 memor 词根前加了 com-。

definition_en: to make someone remember something they might forget, or to make them think of it
core_image: 有人轻轻碰一下你的胳膊，指着你差点忘掉的东西
scene: 出门前，母亲在门口叫住他，说下午还有一节牙医预约。As he left, his mother reminded him of the dentist appointment that afternoon.
sceneCN: 这里 remind 是「提醒」（第 1 个义项：使某人记起可能会忘的事）；句意：他出门时，母亲提醒他下午还有牙医预约。

derivatives.zh: remind 加 -er 构成，义为「提醒；提示物」
remind 的第二成分，义为「心思；头脑」

senses.title: To make someone remember a duty
senses.definition: to tell someone about something they must do or must not forget
senses.definitionCN: 告诉某人必须做或不能忘记的事
senses.example: The nurse reminded him to take his pills after dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 护士提醒他晚饭后吃药。
senses.why: The word is a plain compound of re- and mind, so the picture is putting something back into someone's mind.
senses.whyCN: 这个词就是 re- 与 mind 的简单复合，画面是把某件事重新放进某人的心里。

senses.title: To make someone think of something
senses.definition: to cause someone to remember a person, place, or feeling through similarity
senses.definitionCN: 因相似而使人想起某个人、地方或感觉
senses.example: This song reminds me of my summer in the north.
senses.exampleCN: 这首歌让我想起在北方度过的那个夏天。
senses.why: A sight or sound can put a memory back into the mind without any duty involved, which is this sense.
senses.whyCN: 一个景象或声音可以不经任何职责，就把记忆重新放回心里，这就是第二义项。

intro.en: Remind is an English compound of the prefix re- and the native noun mind, first recorded in the seventeenth century.
intro.cn: remind 是英语本土复合词，由前缀 re- 与本土名词 mind 构成，最早见于十七世纪。

items.en: The noun gemynd means memory and mind, and becomes modern English mind.
items.cn: 古英语名词 gemynd 表示记忆与心智，后来演变为现代英语的 mind。

items.en: The prefix re- enters English through French and Latin and means again or back.
items.cn: 前缀 re- 经法语与拉丁语进入英语，表示「再次、回」。

items.en: Remind is formed to mean put a thing back into someone's mind.
items.cn: remind 被构造出来，表示「把某事重新放进某人心里」。

items.en: The pattern remind someone of something becomes established for similarity.
items.cn: 十八世纪，remind someone of something 这一句型固定下来，用于表示相似引起的联想。

items.en: The noun reminder turns the verb into a thing that prompts, such as an alarm or a note.
items.cn: 名词 reminder 把动词变成一个起提示作用的事物，例如闹钟或便条。

note.en: Remind is a native compound whose second half is mind, and it stands opposite remember in direction.
note.cn: remind 是第二个成分 mind 的本土复合词，与 remember 的方向相反。

entries.definitionCN: 提醒；提示物，由 remind 加 -er 构成

entries.definition: the part of a person that thinks and remembers
entries.definitionCN: 心智；头脑，是 remind 的第二成分

entries.definition: to keep or bring something into your own mind
entries.definitionCN: 记得；想起，与 remind 拼写相近但方向相反

entries.definition: to cause someone to do or say something
entries.definitionCN: 促使；提示，常用于舞台或软件

entries.definition: to warn someone about a danger or problem
entries.definitionCN: 向……报警；提醒注意，带有警告意味

entries.definition: to push someone gently, often to make them act

normalIntro.en: Remind is simply re- plus mind, so the word means putting something back into a mind.
normalIntro.cn: remind 就是 re- 加 mind，意思是把某件事重新放回心里。

normal.en: Remember is what you do yourself; remind is what someone else does to you.
normal.cn: remember 是自己记得，remind 是别人来提醒你。

normal.en: Add -er for reminder, the thing that does the prompting.
normal.cn: 加 -er 得到 reminder，即起提示作用的事物。

normal.en: Remind someone of takes a noun, while remind someone to takes a verb.
normal.cn: remind sb of 后接名词，remind sb to 后接动词。

normal.en: A calendar alert is a digital reminder in everyday life.
normal.cn: 日历提醒就是日常生活中的数字 reminder。

normal.en: The second half is the native word mind, not the Latin root ment-.
normal.cn: 第二个成分是本土词 mind，而不是拉丁词根 ment-。

abstract.en: Picture a hand tapping your arm just as you reach for the wrong door.
abstract.cn: 想象你正要开错门时，一只手轻轻碰了碰你的胳膊。

abstract.en: See a yellow note stuck to a laptop screen.
abstract.cn: 想象笔记本电脑屏幕上贴着一张黄色便条。

abstract.en: Think of a smell that instantly brings back a kitchen from childhood.
abstract.cn: 想一种气味，瞬间把童年的厨房带回来。

examples.en: Please remind me to call the bank tomorrow.
examples.cn: 请提醒我明天给银行打电话。

examples.en: That photograph reminds her of her grandmother.
examples.cn: 那张照片让她想起她的祖母。

examples.en: The teacher reminded the class about the deadline.
examples.cn: 老师提醒全班注意截止日期。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「瑞曼的」——想象瑞丽那位慢吞吞的人总被人轻轻提醒；只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 英语本土复合词：前缀 re-（再次）加名词 mind（心智、记忆），字面即「重新放入心中」。

sensesIntro.en: Putting something back into a mind covers both a duty that must not be forgotten and a memory stirred by resemblance.
sensesIntro.cn: 把某事重新放进心里，既涵盖不能忘记的职责，也涵盖因相似而被唤起的回忆。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a light tap on the arm pointing at something nearly forgotten.
core.cn: 核心意象：有人轻碰你的胳膊，指向你差点忘掉的东西。

branches.en: A duty put back into the mind is the practical everyday sense.
branches.cn: 把职责重新放回心里，是最实际的日常义项。

branches.en: A sight that stirs a memory does the same work without any duty.
branches.cn: 触动记忆的景象做着同样的事，却与职责无关。

branches.en: Both are cases of something returning to mind from outside.
branches.cn: 两者都是某事物从外部回到心里的情形。

branches.en: Repeated reminders turn a prompt into a small warning.
branches.cn: 反复提醒会把提示变成小小的警告。

branches.en: Resemblance is the most common trigger of spontaneous recall.
branches.cn: 相似是最常见的自发回忆触发器。

intro.en: Remind is a rare case of a Latin prefix joined to a native English noun.
intro.cn: remind 是拉丁前缀与英语本土名词结合的少见例子。

latinIntro.en: The prefix re- means again, and mind is the native word for the thinking and remembering part of a person.
latinIntro.cn: 前缀 re- 表示「再次」，mind 是英语本族词，指人思考与记忆的部分。

items.example: Re- puts the thing back where it belongs.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 re- 表示把它放回原处。

items.example: Mind is a native word of Germanic origin.
items.exampleCN: mind 是源自日耳曼语的本土词。

items.example: Reminder is the thing that prompts.
items.exampleCN: reminder 是起提示作用的事物。

items.example: Gemynd is the Old English ancestor of mind.
items.exampleCN: gemynd 是 mind 的古英语祖先。

items.meaning: a prompt or a note that reminds
items.example: A reminder can be a sound, a message, or a note.
items.exampleCN: reminder 可以是声音、消息或便条。

items.example: Mindful shows the noun mind with the ending -ful.
items.exampleCN: mindful 展示了名词 mind 加 -ful 的形式。

items.example: Memory is the Latin partner of the native mind.
items.exampleCN: memory 是本土词 mind 的拉丁对应词。

items.meaning: to keep or bring into your own mind
items.example: Remember reverses the direction of remind.
items.exampleCN: remember 与 remind 的方向相反。
